title: iicw-lightweight
label: Zach Mowers

won.source: Third-party résumé attestations OUTSIDE the fed's own posts: "went 3-0 in [the] IICW, winning the Lightweight title" (U6agAYiS73AJ, 18 Dec 1997) and "5-0 carrer with a lightweight title to his name from [the] IICW" (b4UjgdvcTcwJ, 12 Dec 1997).

how: Won the eight-man tournament across the fed's own first three shows; the tournament's own final is not narrated in a document this collection holds.
note: No `event` link: the fed's own posts never state the Lightweight final's own result; the reign is known only from two later third-party résumé mentions.
